 "data": "flowchart TD
 A([Start: dependency updates]) --> B[Select next dependency]
 B --> C{Safe to merge?}
C -- No --> D[Set PR to Draft<br/>Comment why it is unsafe]
D --> E{More dependencies?}

C -- Yes --> F{Propagated downstream?}
F -- No --> G[Classify code use<br/>Use fix(deps):, test(deps):, or chore(deps):]
G --> H{Are there comments associated with this dependency,<br/>or references to it from another dependency?}
F -- Yes / Not sure --> H

H -- Yes --> I[Fix or remove the dependency<br/>or related problem]
I --> E
H -- No --> E

E -- Yes --> B
E -- No --> J[Cherry-pick other safe updates<br/>into selected Pull Request]

J --> K{Any dependency issues to resolve?}
K -- Yes --> L[Fix dependency issues]
K -- No --> M{Could the updates cause downstream problems?}
L --> M

M -- Yes --> N[Test in downstream service]
N --> O[Approve PR]
M -- No --> O

O --> P[Rebase and merge PR]
P --> Q([Done])

R[All commits must use clear,<br/>understandable Semantic Commit messages]
R -. applies throughout .-> B",
 "config": null
